reason: Stack-exhaustion DoS on deeply nested glob patterns. No fixed braces release exists (3.0.3 is the latest and is affected). Since the Tailwind 4 upgrade it is reached only through eslint-config-next (@next/eslint-plugin-next -> fast-glob 3.3.1 -> micromatch -> braces), which expands lint patterns written in this repo, never user input, and is not in the production bundle. Re-check at expiry: the fix is a fast-glob/micromatch release that drops it, or a braces fix.
